description: Drops a note from a polyphonic note stream when another channel is already sounding the same pitch, and can delay the gate input by a few samples

params.text: Delays the gate input by 0 to 5 samples, for when the CV from an upstream module arrives later than its gate

inputs.text: Pitch in, sampled on each rising gate on the matching channel
Gates marking the notes; the number of channels here sets the polyphony of all three outputs
A second CV, for velocity or panning, sampled on each rising gate on the matching channel

outputs.text: Pitch of the notes that were kept
Gate of each note that was kept; a note whose pitch matches one already sounding on another channel produces no gate
CV2 of the notes that were kept

notes: the inputs are sampled and held on the gates, so modulation that moves between gates does not pass through
